svg.title: Acting on review findings: Cost and time
svg.desc: Acting on review findings. Cost and recorded time, with the highest total in each matched comparison set to 100%. 12 matched tasks. Cost: Compact 74.6%, Fresh 85.3%, Continue 100.0%. Time: Compact 85.7%, Continue 92.8%, Fresh 100.0%. Each comparison sorts ascending.
